description: This file is a Perl script named package-metadata.pl, designed to extract, process, and generate various metadata information for a software project, including package dependencies, configurations, sources, licenses, and JSON representations of package manifest data. It contains multiple subroutines for parsing package metadata, generating configuration files, and producing JSON outputs for package dependencies and SBOMs.

methods.name: version_to_num
methods.description: Converts a version string into a numerical value for comparison purposes.

methods.name: version_filter_list
methods.description: Filters a list of version strings based on a comparison version.

methods.name: gen_kconfig_overrides
methods.description: Generates kernel config overrides based on package info and build system config.

methods.name: __find_package_dep
methods.description: Recursively finds if a package depends on another package within dependencies.

methods.name: find_package_dep
methods.description: Wrapper for dependency search to avoid infinite recursion.

methods.name: package_depends
methods.description: Determines dependency relation between two packages.

methods.name: mconf_depends
methods.description: Generates dependency logic for package configuration.

methods.name: mconf_conflicts
methods.description: Generates conflict dependency conditions for packages.

methods.name: print_package_config_category
methods.description: Prints the configuration options for a package category, including submenus.

methods.name: print_package_overrides
methods.description: Prints override configurations for packages.

methods.name: gen_package_config
methods.description: Generates the package configuration file based on parsed metadata.

methods.name: gen_package_source
methods.description: Outputs package source file information.

methods.name: gen_package_auxiliary
methods.description: Outputs auxiliary variables for packages like repository subdirs and dependencies.

methods.name: gen_package_license
methods.description: Outputs licensing information for packages.

methods.name: gen_version_filtered_list
methods.description: Outputs a filtered list of version strings.

methods.name: gen_usergroup_list
methods.description: Outputs a list of user and group allocations.

methods.name: gen_package_manifest_json
methods.description: Produces a JSON array of package manifest data including dependencies, licenses, and maintainers.

methods.name: image_manifest_packages
methods.description: Reads image manifest file and returns a hash of package names and their versions.

methods.name: dump_cyclonedxsbom_json
methods.description: Generates a CycloneDX SBOM JSON structure from component data.

methods.name: gen_image_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates CycloneDX SBOM JSON for image packages, including license and category info.

methods.name: gen_package_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates CycloneDX SBOM JSON for package manifests, similar to image SBOM but from package metadata.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and dispatches commands like mk, config, source, etc.
